description: Fetches the specific deposit address for the TronSave internal account. Requires an internal API key: `tronsave_login` (api-key mode, or signature mode for a wallet with an internal account) or an `Authorization: ApiKey <key>` client header. Never pass API keys as tool arguments; the server forwards the key from the session/header to TronSave. Trigger this tool if the user asks for a deposit address or needs to top up their TronSave TRX balance. Constraints: 1) TRX only; 2) Minimum deposit amount is 10 TRX; 3) Read-only operation.

amountTrx.description: Amount of TRX the user intends to deposit (minimum 10 TRX).
